desc: Ideation: model as binary search on D + max clique / MIS, use interval-based forbidden masks.
Implement binary search over D from 0 to side with a `feasible(D)` helper.
Replace clique search with the cycle mapping (L = 4*side) + greedy earliest-successor + binary lifting feasibility test (polynomial reduction).
Handle edge cases: corner assignment (y==0, y==side, x==0, else right), strict inequality, D<=0, sentinel index, wrap-around deadline check.
Hand-verify samples 1-3 and side=1/k=4 against the reduction (matches 2,1,1,1).
Execute the validator: RAW sample PASS (2/1/1), OVERALL PASS, stress mismatches=0, n=15000 timing within limits.

Prove binary-search range [0, side] is complete: for k>=4 any 4 boundary points contain a pair with Manhattan distance <= side, and for D <= side cyclic distance equals Manhattan distance, so the cycle-proxy feasibility is exact.
